label: User-supplied FIRMS-format data; source not independently authenticated. Research preview, not operational guidance.

report.external_validation: Not performed; no independent fire perimeter or incident labels were provided.
limitations: Centroid distance and cell assignment approximate pixel footprints; scan and track do not provide orientation.
Pair edges are potential co-observations, not confirmed fires; one-to-many candidate edges are not incident counts.
Unknown observation opportunities, cloud and sensor coverage; unmatched observations are not false negatives.
NOAA-20 excluded from reference cohort because processing type is unresolved; sensitivity contains an all-satellite scenario.
FRP is retained separately by sensor; no cross-sensor sum or fire energy is calculated.
Maui coastline comes from 1983 source geometry and is not a legal boundary.
2023 descriptive counts were visible during the ingestion audit before configuration freeze; evaluation is not fully blinded.
